text: ‘Globalisation is leading to greater cultural diversity.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘Dependency theory provides the most convincing explanation of global poverty.’ Evaluate this
view. [35]
Section B: Media
EITHER
‘Governments have no control over the new media.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘The uses and gratifications model accurately describes how people are influenced by the media.’
Evaluate this view. [35]
Section C: Religion
EITHER
‘Religion is an agent of social control.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘The growth of new religious movements shows that religion remains a powerful influence in
society.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
